command:
# G2 follow-up (docs/g2.md; scripts/g2/nvme2.plan) on the box of runs/g2-nvme.json, with the same
# staging and builds: upstream kraken2 at the pin (pristine; built from source here) on RODA v205
# on instance-store NVMe (RAID0 over both devices), --memory-mapping at read_ahead_kb 4, 128 and
# the default, the per-accession baseline, profiles, and rep 2 of the madv (diagnostic) ladders.
# Reads, database checks and fail-fast setup as in runs/g2-nvme.json.
W=$HOME/ak2; mkdir -p "$W"
SHA=${AK2_RUN_ID##*-}
B=aws-kraken2-942542972736-us-west-2; DATA=aws-kraken2/data
fail() { ak2_say "ERROR: $*"; exit 1; }
G2_DEADLINE=$(( $(date +%s) + 220 * 60 )); export G2_DEADLINE

ak2_phase setup
sudo -n dnf install -y -q git > "$W/dnf0.log" 2>&1 || fail "dnf git failed"
git clone -q https://github.com/scttfrdmn/aws-kraken2.git "$W/repo" || fail "clone failed"
git -C "$W/repo" checkout -q "$SHA" || fail "checkout $SHA failed"
cd "$W/repo" || fail "no repo"
. scripts/g2-instance.sh
g2i_setup
g2i_nvme

ak2_phase fetch-reads
RD=$G2_NVME/reads
g2i_stage_reads "$RD" "$B" "$DATA" SRR062634_8000000 SRR062634_200000 ERR478965_200000 ERR598966_200000 SRR28305653_200000
g2i_subset "$RD" SRR062634_8000000 2000000 SRR062634_2000000
g2i_subset "$RD" SRR062634_8000000 250000 SRR062634_250000
g2i_gzip_rate "$RD/SRR062634_2000000_1.fq.gz"

# The builds run while the database streams in.
ak2_phase fetch-db
( g2i_build > "$W/build.out" 2>&1 ) &
BUILD_PID=$!
g2i_awscfg 25Gb/s
DB=$G2_NVME/db/RefSeqCompleteV205
g2i_stage_roda "$DB"
wait "$BUILD_PID" || { cat "$W/build.out"; fail "build failed"; }
cat "$W/build.out"
G2_UPSTREAM=$(scripts/oracle-build.sh) && G2_MADV=$(scripts/madvrandom-build.sh) || fail "builds not found"
export G2_UPSTREAM G2_MADV

G2_PLAN=scripts/g2/nvme2.plan G2_DB=$DB G2_READS=$RD G2_WORK=$G2_NVME/work G2_LABEL=nvme2 G2_RUNG_TIMEOUT=1800
export G2_PLAN G2_DB G2_READS G2_WORK G2_LABEL G2_RUNG_TIMEOUT
. scripts/g2.sh
RC=$?
ak2_say "g2 nvme2 rc=$RC"
ak2_phase push
[ "$RC" = 0 ] || exit "$RC"
exit 0
